description: Hands a 12- or 24-word seed phrase to NFPT's orchard-scanner CLI, returns the matching UFVK. FREE but rate-limited to 6/minute/IP. Be loud about the security trade-off: the phrase transits our server (no logging, no persistence) but a network observer between you and us would see the bytes. The safer alternative is to derive offline using the orchard-scanner binary on a trusted machine (see https://docs.seneschal.space/derive-locally). A UFVK is read-only; it cannot spend funds.

chain.description: Currently only Zcash (Orchard) UFVK derivation is supported; Monero coming later.

network.description: Zcash network the wallet belongs to.
